semantic_rationale: Reveal meaning, establish solid form, then accent it without disturbing reading.

new_operator.name: Contour-guided solid reveal
equations: For an authored normalized contour coordinate a(p) in [0,1], alpha(p,s)=smoothstep(-f,f,s-a(p)), feather f=.03; preserve the complete target mesh at s=1.
Grow glyph depth as depth(s)=.005+.155*s em after the contour reveal; hold the measured final pose before exit.
